products.shortDescription: Majestic emerald green Agbada with hand-stitched gold embroidery for grand celebrations.
products.name: Royal Emerald Agbada
products.description: A majestic emerald green Agbada crafted from premium Swiss cotton with hand-stitched gold embroidery. This three-piece ensemble features a flowing outer robe, fitted inner tunic, and matching trousers. Perfect for weddings, chieftaincy ceremonies, and grand celebrations. The intricate embroidery patterns are inspired by traditional Yoruba motifs, reimagined with contemporary elegance. Each piece takes approximately 3 weeks to complete, ensuring every stitch meets our exacting standards.

products.shortDescription: Premium espresso brown kaftan crafted from luxurious soft-finish cotton, featuring a relaxed oversized fit, clean band collar, and matching trousers.
products.name: Espresso Heritage Kaftan
products.description: A refined espresso brown kaftan designed for the modern gentleman who values understated luxury. Tailored from premium soft-finish cotton with a structured drape, this two-piece ensemble features a relaxed oversized top with wide sleeves, a clean band collar, concealed front placket, and matching straight-cut trousers. Its minimalist silhouette is elevated by impeccable craftsmanship and precision tailoring, creating a timeless piece that commands attention without excess. Ideal for exclusive gatherings, Friday prayers, cultural celebrations, and sophisticated evening occasions, the Espresso Heritage Kaftan embodies quiet confidence and effortless elegance.

products.shortDescription: Pristine ivory senator wear with clean lines and minimal embroidery for versatile elegance.
products.name: Ivory Senator Set
products.description: A pristine ivory senator wear set that exudes quiet confidence and refined taste. The clean lines and minimal embroidery make this piece incredibly versatile, suitable for both business meetings and social events. Crafted from high-quality cotton-linen blend that breathes beautifully in the Nigerian climate. The precision-cut trousers feature a comfortable yet tailored fit.

products.shortDescription: Bold burgundy two-piece suit in premium English wool with peak lapels and full canvas construction.
products.name: Burgundy English Suit
products.description: A bold burgundy two-piece suit that commands attention while maintaining sophistication. Tailored using premium English wool with a subtle herringbone pattern. The jacket features peak lapels, double vents, and functional buttonholes. Fully canvassed construction ensures the jacket molds to your body over time. Perfect for the gentleman who isn't afraid to stand out.

products.shortDescription: Premium heavyweight hoodie with Lagos-inspired graphics and Adire-dye patterns. Limited edition.
products.name: Lagos Street Hoodie
products.description: A premium heavyweight hoodie featuring original Lagos-inspired graphics and Adire-dye inspired patterns. Made from 450gsm organic cotton with a relaxed oversized fit. The dropped shoulders and extended sleeves create a contemporary silhouette. Each piece is hand-finished with embroidered details on the sleeve. Limited edition release.

products.shortDescription: Grand Isiagu chieftaincy set in premium velvet with iconic lion-head pattern and gold trim.
products.name: Isiagu Chieftaincy Set
products.description: A grand Isiagu set befitting royalty and title holders. The iconic lion-head pattern is woven into premium velvet, creating a rich texture that catches the light beautifully. The set includes a flowing wrapper, matching top, and traditional cap (red cap). Gold-trimmed embroidery along the edges adds an extra layer of opulence. This is ceremonial wear at its finest.

products.shortDescription: Sophisticated charcoal grey kaftan with minimal embroidery in premium Egyptian cotton.

The understated elegance of this piece makes it perfect for the modern gentleman who appreciates subtle luxury. Made from premium Egyptian cotton with a matte finish. The relaxed fit provides all-day comfort while maintaining a sharp silhouette.
